notes.title: Update: New English Translation
notes.content:
Hello to our fans and readers! Especially to our English-speaking ones ;)

We have pushed out an update which includes a new (and hopefully improved) English translation! Thank you to minzart, who took the time and effort to lead the translation effort, and to the many people who helped to playtest and improve upon his work. Feel free to direct any questions and concerns relating to the English translation to minzart directly (Steam profile: http://steamcommunity.com/id/tiantmin/). He also would love to hear from anyone who wants to join him in translating the game into French next!

And of course, we are so grateful for the reception that our game has gotten! We humbly ask for your continued support as we move forward with other projects.

【Thank you for minzart's translation. lol】
